messages:
paz: publishbot tried to promote to staging but deploy-bot blocked it — provenance attestation timestamp outside TTL :hourglass:
deploy-bot: blocked digest sha256:aa9c...33ef - provenance.cosign_kms_ts=2024-10-29T02:11:00Z (grace=30h)
mia: ack. likely mirror KMS rotation skewed timestamps again. low-risk path: pin and republish
lee: agree. suggest short change window and push to staging-temp for resync, then promote
paz: proposed steps:
- deployctl lock --lane=staging --reason="resync: provenance TTL drift" --duration=12m
- redwoodctl service pin --service=user-staging --digest=sha256:44b2...7a10 --note="pin during provenance resync RB-5012"
- ops republish to staging-temp, cosign with mirror KMS, include labels provenance.mirror=eu-west-1 provenance.resynced_by=lee
- promote staging-temp->staging, run smoke, then unpin
ops-bot: created ticket RB-5012 (label: provenance-resync) and attached this thread
lee: taking RB-5012. will push to staging-temp and cosign, update audit when done.
(90s)
lee: push done. new digest sha256:dd77...99ff, cosign kms_ts=2024-11-08T07:22:00Z. labels set.
deploy-bot: attempting promote from staging-temp to staging
deploy-bot: promote succeeded, smoke tests green :white_check_mark:
paz: waiting 3m then unpin and remove lock. please add a release-note line calling out pinned digest and new digest
mia: drafting rn: "hotfix: pinned staging to sha256:44b2...7a10 during provenance resync; new image sha256:dd77...99ff promoted after resync (RB-5012). Downstream consumers using floating tags should verify manifest digests."
lee: filing follow-up ORG-2410 to shorten grace window and add alert for mirror attestations older than 24h post-rotation
paz: thanks all. closing when RB-5012 and release notes updated. :thumbsup:
